issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Clueso MCP
products.tagline: Create and edit videos by chatting
products.summaryZh: 通过聊天创建和编辑视频
products.descriptionZh: 使用 Claude、ChatGPT 或任意 AI 智能体制作视频。给 Clueso 一个想法、演示文稿、参考视频或录屏，它就能完成整个视频制作流程：分镜、场景、配音、音乐和剪辑，并保持品牌一致。所有内容始终可编辑，手动或通过对话均可。
products.description: Make videos with Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent. Give Clueso an idea, deck, reference video, or recording, and it handles the whole video production: storyboard, scenes, voiceover, music, and editing, on-brand. Everything stays editable, by hand or by chat.

products.name: WZRD
products.tagline: AI-native documents, slides, forms and sheets that talk back
products.summaryZh: 原生 AI 文档、幻灯片、表单和表格，能与你对话
products.descriptionZh: WZRD 适用于处理文档、幻灯片、表单和表格的团队与创作者。上传现有作品或通过提示创建，然后将其转化为用户可参与的 AI 体验。表单通过语音或打字收集答案。表格大声解释数字。幻灯片引导人们了解故事。文档吸引每一位用户。输出保持对话式和响应式。
products.description: WZRD is for teams and creators working with documents, slides, forms and sheets. Upload existing work or create from a prompt, then turn it into an AI experience users can engage with. Forms collect answers by speaking or typing. Sheets explain numbers out loud. Slides walk people through the story. Documents engage every user. The output stays conversational and responsive.

products.name: Anomalo
products.tagline: Your data is always talking. Don't miss what it's saying.
products.summaryZh: 你的数据始终在诉说。别错过它传递的信息。
products.descriptionZh: 你的数据时刻在变。Anomalo Analyst 在你意识到该问什么之前，就告诉你什么才是关键。它主动监控你的 Snowflake、Databricks 或 BigQuery 数据，揭示重要趋势、异常和变化，并让你用平实的语言通过后续提问深入探究。每一条洞察都经过你的数据验证，Anomalo 助你区分真实的业务变化与损坏的数据。
products.description: Your data changes constantly. Anomalo Analyst tells you what matters before you know to ask. It proactively monitors your Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery data, surfaces important trends, anomalies, and shifts, and lets you investigate with follow-up questions in plain language. Every insight is verified against your data, with Anomalo helping distinguish real business changes from broken data.

products.name: SereneDB
products.tagline: Ultra-Fast Search & Analytics Database, Agentic AI ready
products.summaryZh: 超高速搜索与分析数据库，支持智能体AI
products.descriptionZh: SereneDB 是 12 年研发的成果——一个开源数据库，在单一引擎中实现超快全文检索和快速分析。兼容 Postgres 和 Elastic：保留你的 SQL、驱动程序和 Elastic 客户端；去掉第二个系统以及两者之间的 ETL。在我们的公开基准测试中，它的性能优于 Elasticsearch、ClickHouse 和 Postgres 搜索扩展，并在不到 8 分钟内索引 10 亿条日志，磁盘占用减少约 10 倍。Apache 2.0、测试方法和原始结果均已公开。
products.description: SereneDB is the result of 12 years of development - an open-source database that does ultra-fast full-text and fast analytics in one engine. Postgres- and Elastic-compatible: keep your SQL, your drivers, and your Elastic clients; drop the second system and the ETL between them. In our public benchmark, it outperforms Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, and Postgres search extensions, and indexes 1B logs in under 8 minutes at ~10x less disk. Apache 2.0, methodology, and raw results are public.

products.name: thestory.run
products.tagline: A writing coach for corporate influencers.
products.summaryZh: 企业影响者的写作教练。
products.descriptionZh: 你的团队其实有话说，只是不知道怎么说。我们的教练帮你保持稳定输出，找到值得分享的故事，让你成为写作者。大多数 AI 工具会替你写。thestory.run 反过来：教练采访你，找到你反复绕着的那个点，把故事脉络交给你，由你来写。正是这位教练陪你走完全程：一次真实的会话，从一个混乱的想法到一篇完成的帖子。在帖子与帖子之间，它帮你安排好一周，让你永远不必猜下一步是什么。
products.description: Your team already has things to say, they just don't know how. Our coach helps you stay consistent, find stories worth sharing and makes YOU the writer. Most AI tools take over writing. thestory.run flips it: the coach interviews you, finds the point you're circling, hands you the story arc, and you write it. It is the coach that helps you through it all: One real session, from a messy thought to a finished post. Between the posts, it keeps the week so you never have to guess what's next

products.name: Freebuff Ads
products.tagline: Advertise to 500k developers in our coding agent
products.summaryZh: 在我们的编程代理中向50万开发者投放广告
products.descriptionZh: 在Freebuff桌面应用、移动端、网页端和CLI中投放广告——50万开发者已在此工作。按点击付费，自行设置上限，在一个控制台中衡量点击和转化。
products.description: Run ads inside the Freebuff desktop app, mobile, web, and CLI - where 500k developers are already working. Pay per click, set your own caps, and measure clicks and conversions in one console.

products.name: PixelCrew
products.tagline: Production-ready design from a crew of AI agents
products.summaryZh: 由AI智能体团队打造的生产级设计
products.descriptionZh: 一支专业 AI 智能体团队围绕你的需求简报协同工作，交付达到生产质量的设计。涵盖调研、创意方向、线框图，以及附带设计系统的生产级 HTML。运行过程中，你可以观看智能体讨论各项决策。Alpha 阶段免费：自带 OpenRouter 密钥，随意选用模型来运行这支团队。
products.description: A crew of specialized AI agents coordinates on your brief and ships production-quality design. Research, creative direction, wireframes, and production-ready HTML with a design system. You can watch the agents discuss decisions while it runs. Free in alpha: bring your own OpenRouter key and run the crew on whichever models you like.

products.name: Plane Agents
products.tagline: Assign work to AI agents, like any teammate
products.summaryZh: 像对待任何队友一样，给AI代理分配工作
products.descriptionZh: Plane Agents 作为成员加入你的工作区。你可以为它们分配工作项、添加标签、在工作变更时触发它们，或按计划运行它们。它们会分诊请求、起草规格、主持站会、标记交付风险，以及完成更多工作。Agents 使用每个付费计划中包含的 AI 额度运行。
products.description: Plane Agents join your workspace as members. Assign them work items, tag them, trigger them when work changes, or run them on a schedule. They triage requests, draft specs, run standups, flag delivery risks and a lot more. Agents run on the AI credits included in every paid plan.

products.name: MiMo-V2.6
products.tagline: Open omnimodal intelligence, trained in public
products.summaryZh: 开放的全模态智能，基于公开数据训练
products.descriptionZh: MiMo-V2.6 是小米面向长周期智能体任务的开源全模态模型系列。Pro 和 Flash 支持文本、图像、音频和视频，上下文长度达 1M，同时小米还发布了公开后训练运行背后的技术报告、强化学习环境和训练代码。
products.description: MiMo-V2.6 is Xiaomi’s open omnimodal model family for long-horizon agent work. Pro and Flash handle text, images, audio and video with 1M context, while Xiaomi is also releasing the technical report, RL environments and training code behind the public post-training run.

products.name: Pulsetic RUM
products.tagline: Uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors
products.summaryZh: 衡量真实访客的正常运行时间监控
products.descriptionZh: Pulsetic 是一款正常运行时间监控工具，也能衡量真实访客的体验。一个异步脚本即可报告核心网页指标、加载时间百分位数以及访客遇到的 JavaScript 错误，并按页面、国家、浏览器和设备细分，让你发现那些被 200 响应码掩盖的缓慢结账流程。用自然语言向 Pulsetic AI 询问昨晚出了什么问题。Cron 心跳、域名到期提醒和品牌化状态页面都在同一个账户中运行。
products.description: Pulsetic is uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors too. One async script reports Core Web Vitals, load-time percentiles and the JavaScript errors they hit, sliced by page, country, browser and device, so you catch the slow checkout that a 200 response code hides. Ask Pulsetic AI what broke last night in plain language. Cron heartbeats, domain expiry and branded status pages run in the same account.

products.name: WeWeb MCP
products.tagline: Your AI agent builds the app. You stay in control.
products.summaryZh: 你的AI代理构建应用。你始终掌控全局。
products.descriptionZh: 将 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT 或任何 MCP 代理指向 WeWeb，它就能构建页面、工作流、数据模型、表格、身份验证和集成。每一处更改都会进入可视化编辑器，你可以自行查看和编辑。你的代理、你的 token、你的代码。没有黑箱。
products.description: Point Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT or any MCP agent at WeWeb and it builds the pages, workflows, data models, tables, auth and integrations. Every change lands in a visual editor you can review and edit yourself. Your agent, your tokens, your code. No black box.

products.name: Keet
products.tagline: Video Courses on Anything
products.summaryZh: 任何领域的视频课程
products.descriptionZh: 通过互动视频课程学习任何主题。
products.description: Learn anything with interactive video courses on any topic.

products.name: Grok 4.7
products.tagline: SpaceXAI's most powerful model for coding and knowledge work
products.summaryZh: SpaceXAI 用于编程和知识工作的最强大模型
products.descriptionZh: Grok 4.7 是我们在编程和知识工作方面能力最强的模型。它在处理困难任务时能持续更长时间，更仔细地检查自身工作，并配备了迄今为止校准最为精准的安全防护措施。其服务价格和速度与 Grok 4.6 相同，在同级别中极具竞争力。
products.description: Grok 4.7 is our most capable model for coding and knowledge work. It works longer on difficult tasks, checks its own work more carefully, and comes with our best-calibrated safeguards to date. Served at the same price and speed as Grok 4.6, it is highly competitive in its class.

products.name: Hola AI
products.tagline: An AI voicemail assistant that answers calls when you can’t.
products.summaryZh: 一款AI语音留言助手，在你无法接听时代为接听电话。
products.descriptionZh: Hola AI 在你无法接听时接听电话，与来电者交谈，记录留言，过滤垃圾来电，并即时发送通话摘要。它还能录制并转写对话，帮助你了解来电原因，并在回电前为你提供所需的背景信息。无需接听每一通电话，也能保持联系。
products.description: Hola AI answers calls when you can't, speaks with callers, takes messages, filters spam, and sends instant call summaries. It also records and transcribes conversations, helps you understand why someone called, and gives you the context you need before calling back. Stay reachable without picking up every call.

products.name: gg-friggin-ez
products.tagline: Fast & free profanity and toxicity screening via Jev & Laya
products.summaryZh: 通过 Jev 和 Laya 进行快速且免费的亵渎和毒性筛查
products.descriptionZh: 快速、免费、即插即用的多语言脏话与毒性内容筛查器，适用于 Node.js，由 TypeSafe AI Jev 和 Laya 等 System 1 模型驱动。可识别 leetspeak、ASCII 图案、字符间隔，以及包括卡纳达语、泰卢固语、泰米尔语、印地语和孟加拉语在内的所有语言中的罗马化脏话。超低成本 • 多语言 • 原生印度语系支持 • 规避感知 • 低于 500ms • 约 $0.000004/条消息 • 可配置审核操作 • 开源（npm i gg-friggin-ez）
products.description: Fast, free, drop-in multilingual profanity and toxicity screener for Node.js, powered by System 1 models like TypeSafe AI Jev and Laya. Catches leetspeak, ASCII drawings, character spacing, and romanized profanity across all languages including Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, and Bengali. Ultra-low cost • Multilingual • Native Indic support • Evasion-aware • Sub-500ms • ~$0.000004/message • Configurable moderation actions • Open source (npm i gg-friggin-ez)

products.name: Fulvid
products.tagline: A standalone desktop editor for Markdown and MDX
products.summaryZh: 一款独立的桌面编辑器，适用于Markdown和MDX。
products.descriptionZh: Fulvid 是一款面向开放知识的开源 Markdown 与 MDX 编辑器。将知识以可移植的 Markdown 文件保存在磁盘上，便于阅读、链接、复用、版本管理，并跨工具及 LLM 工作流使用。搜索、预览、文档链接和 Graph 导航均贴近文件系统。无专有仓库或云工作区。
products.description: Fulvid is an open source Markdown and MDX editor for open knowledge. Keep your knowledge in portable Markdown files on disk, ready to read, link, reuse, version, and work with across tools and LLM workflows. Search, preview, document links, and Graph navigation stay close to the filesystem. No proprietary vault or cloud workspace.

products.name: Edyt
products.tagline: AI for text you can't even select. Any app on Mac & Windows
products.summaryZh: 适用于无法选中的文本的AI。适用于Mac和Windows上的任何应用
products.descriptionZh: AI 融入 Mac 和 Windows 上的每一款应用。Ubuntu 即将支持。选中文本，按一个快捷键，结果就落在光标所在处。改写会保留你的语气并遵循你的指令。解释和翻译可按你的要求深入。备选会给出多种表达方式。保存的提示词可作用于你选中的任何内容，并随你的账户同步到每台设备。无法选中？按住 Option 或 Alt，在 PDF、截图或共享屏幕上拖动即可。在你的设备上阅读。免费方案对大多数人来说已经够用。
products.description: AI in every app, on Mac and Windows. Ubuntu next. Select text, press one shortcut, and the result lands where your cursor is. Rewrite keeps your tone and follows your instructions. Explain and Translate go as deep as you ask. Alternatives shows several ways to say it. Saved prompts run on anything you select and follow your account to every machine. Can't select it? Hold Option or Alt and drag over a PDF, screenshot, or shared screen. Read on your device. Free plan is enough for most people.

products.name: QuietGlass
products.tagline: Screen privacy for your Mac, with or without AirPods
products.summaryZh: 为你的Mac提供屏幕隐私保护，无论是否使用AirPods
products.descriptionZh: QuietGlass 是一款免费、开源的 Mac 屏幕隐私应用。佩戴兼容的 AirPods 移开视线时，屏幕会自动模糊。摄像头检测到画面中出现其他人脸时，会向你发出警告或模糊屏幕，即使你仍在注视屏幕也不例外。你可以保护某个窗口或选定区域，模糊敏感文字，或通过专注模式保持当前活动窗口清晰。可选的机主识别功能会在解除摄像头保护前确认是你本人。原生 Swift 开发，支持刘海控制，所有处理均在你的 Mac 上完成。需要 macOS 14 及以上版本。
products.description: QuietGlass is a free, open-source Mac app for screen privacy. Look away with compatible AirPods and your screen blurs. Your camera can spot another face in view and warn you or blur the screen, even while you're still looking. Protect a window or selected area, blur sensitive text, or keep your active window clear with Focus mode. Optional owner recognition checks it's you before clearing camera protection. Native Swift, notch controls, and processing on your Mac. macOS 14+.

products.name: Fez
products.tagline: AI agents that work as a team and make decisions together
products.summaryZh: AI代理协同工作，共同决策
products.descriptionZh: 一款Mac桌面应用，多个AI代理作为一个工作空间的成员协同工作，由房间决定谁承担什么任务。基于nostr和jev构建。
products.description: A desktop app for Mac where several AI agents work together as members of one workspace, and the room decides who takes what. Built on nostr and jev

products.name: Googlebook
products.tagline: The laptop your Android phone has been waiting for
products.summaryZh: 你的安卓手机一直在等待的笔记本电脑
products.descriptionZh: 首款为Gemini Intelligence设计的笔记本电脑。Googlebook采用优质材料打造，性能强劲，并能与手机无缝同步。
products.description: The first laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence. Googlebook is crafted with premium materials for powerful performance, and syncs effortlessly with your phone.
